projects.title: Prototypal Inheritance & Prototype Chain Introspection
projects.description: Build an inheritance hierarchy using Object.create() and constructor functions, inspecting __proto__, prototype, and Object.getPrototypeOf().
projects.exampleOutput: Student greeted: 'Hello, Swadeep' | isPrototypeOf verified: true
projects.learningOutcome: Understanding the prototypal nature of JavaScript and constructor function linkage.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Prototypal Inheritance Mechanics (ECMA-262 §10.1)**:
In JavaScript, objects have an internal slot `[[Prototype]]` pointing to another object. When a property is queried, V8 traverses up the prototype chain until the property is found or `null` is reached.
2. **`Object.create(proto)`**:
Creates a new object whose `[[Prototype]]` is set directly to `proto` without running a constructor function.
projects.codeExplanation: The script implements classical prototypal inheritance and validates prototype link references with `Object.getPrototypeOf()`.

projects.title: ES6 Class Architecture with True Private Fields (#)
projects.description: Implement an enterprise bank account class utilizing ES2022 private fields (#balance, #pin) and private methods (#auditTransaction) that cannot be accessed from outside.
projects.exampleOutput: Balance: ₹6,000 | acc.#balance accessed externally: SyntaxError (True Private State)
projects.learningOutcome: Mastering ES2022 private fields (#) and contrasting them against closure-based and Symbol-based privacy.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **True Hard Privacy with `#` (ES2022 §15.7)**:
Private fields prefixed with `#` are stored in an internal `[[PrivateElements]]` slot. They cannot be queried via `Object.keys()`, `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols()`, or `Reflect.ownKeys()`.
2. **Compile-Time Enforcement**:
Attempting to read `acc.#balance` outside the class body results in a compile-time `SyntaxError`.
projects.codeExplanation: The script implements `BankAccount` with `#` private state, showing deposit, withdrawal validations, and private auditing.
